<?php
class BufferedThrowPayload20 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; } }
function bufferedThrowChild20() { echo "C|"; try { $received = yield 5; echo "BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CA|", $caught === $GLOBALS["injected"] ? "SAME|" : "OTHER|"; yield 13; echo "TAIL|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } return 17; }
function bufferedThrowMiddle20() { global $child; echo "M|"; try { $result = yield from ($child = bufferedThrowChild20()); echo "MR|", $result, "|"; return 23; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function bufferedThrowOuter20() { global $middle; echo "O|"; try { $result = yield from ($middle = bufferedThrowMiddle20()); echo "OR|", $result, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
echo "P|"; $injected = new Exception("injected20"); $outer = bufferedThrowOuter20(); $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$snapshot = $middle->send(new BufferedThrowPayload20()); echo "S|", $snapshot, "|"; unset($snapshot); echo "T|";
$result = $child->throw($injected); echo "K|", $result, "|"; unset($result); $outer->next(); echo "Q|", $outer->getReturn(), "|";
unset($outer, $middle, $child, $injected); echo "E";
purpose: A direct non-pending throw into the physical paused used-yield child must retire its buffered object before the child catches the exact supplied Exception, then complete genuine yield and return tails.
